descriptions.english: Stored for this battle. To activate a cooling unit ability, spend [sanson.DevaClan_Charge] equal to its remaining cooldown.
descriptions.chinese: 在本场战斗中储存。激活冷却中的单位主动能力时，消耗等于剩余冷却回合数的[sanson.DevaClan_Charge]。[sanson.DevaClan_Charge]不足时无法激活。

descriptions.english: Kill a friendly unit and resummon it in its position. Triggers death and summon effects. Removes temporary buffs and debuffs, except [sanson.DevaClan_karmergy].
descriptions.chinese: 消灭一个友方角色，再在原位置召唤它。触发死亡与召唤效果，清除临时增益与减益，但保留[sanson.DevaClan_karmergy]。

descriptions.english: An artificial lifeform created by the Deva.
descriptions.chinese: 天人创造的机械生命体亚种族。
